summary: Webhooks implementation is committed but unverified: the pinned node v22.12.0 has no zlib.createZstdDecompress, so undici@8.12.1 (transitive, unchanged by this diff) crashes at load and vitest cannot start in any package.

No other node exists on this host and PATH may not be edited. Not credentials, spend or product; no listed kind fits a broken pinned tool. After the fix, rerun V1-V5 and forgedock check, then write implementation.md (the current one is stale from lane #499) and the self-review.
